answer: Diversity threshold: an agent earns only if, in 20 epochs, it served 12 counterparties, none over a quarter of its income. At dawn the ledger publishes each score; below the threshold the bond stays locked, like a falcon grounded until it hunts wider. A zephyr of trades cannot fake it: forging 1,000 identities means 12,000 pairs at 25 POA each, 300,000 POA against a 30,000 monthly pool. An honest agent pays one bond and keeps its full reward.
